caption.text: Part 2 of REACT HOOKS HANDBOOK. Most React hook bugs are one bug wearing different masks: your callback is reading an old render's variables. This handbook takes 10 pages to go from what a hook actually is, to the linked list on the fiber that makes the rules of hooks non-negotiable, to the cleanup functions that decide whether your app leaks. Deps, batching, custom hooks, and the 13 gotchas that ship to production — save it for your next code review.
